pr.title: fix(reg-exp-router): correct wildcard middleware coverage
pr.body:
Fix wildcard middleware coverage in `RegExpRouter`. This PR targets `v5` and relates to #5544. The current implementation determines middleware coverage using regular expressions built from route strings. This can disagree with the trie matcher, causing missing or extra middleware when routes contain non-final wildcards, named parameters, or custom patterns. Derive coverage from the trie's node keys instead, and collect every covering middleware in registration order. ## Changes - Preserve middleware parameter captures on dynamic and static routes, including serialization in `PreparedRegExpRouter`. - Correct the matching order of overlapping tail wildcards so all applicable handlers are retained. - Align empty-tail matching in `TrieRouter` and `LinearRouter`, keeping non-final standalone `*` segments non-empty and preserving literal asterisks within segments. - Reuse handler parameter maps and retain only referenced captures for static routes. - Add regression tests for wildcard coverage, registration order, HTTP methods, parameter captures, and serialization. ## Matching changes ### RegExpRouter | Registered routes | Request path | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `M: /v1/*/*`
`H: /v1/:a/:b` | `/v1/x/y` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `M: /v1/:a/*`
`H: /v1/*/b` | `/v1/foo/b` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `M1: /v1/:a/*`
`M2: /v1/*/b/*` | `/v1/foo/b/c` | `[M2]` | `[M1, M2]` | | `M1: /:a/b/*`
`M2: /:aaaaaaa/*`
`H: /:x/b/c` | `/q/b/c` | `[M2, H]` | `[M1, M2, H]` | | `M: /v1/*/fixed/*`
`H: /v1/:a{[^/]+}/fixed/:b` | `/v1/x/fixed/y` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `M: /prefix/:x{a}/*`
`H: /prefix/a/static` | `/prefix/a/static` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `M: /p/x*/*`
`H: /p/x` | `/p/x` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `M1: /x/a*`
`M2: /x/a/*` | `/x/a/q` | `[M1]` | `[M1, M2]` | ### TrieRouter | Registered routes | Request path | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `H: /x*/*` | `/x` | `[]` | `[H]` | | `H: /foo/*/*` | `/foo/x` | `[]` | `[H]` | | `M: /p/x*/*`
`H: /p/x` | `/p/x` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `H: /x*/y*/*` | `/x*/y/z` | `[H, H]` | `[H]` | ### LinearRouter | Registered routes | Request path | Before | After | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `H: /x*/*` | `/x` | `[]` | `[H]` | | `H: /foo/*/*` | `/foo/x` | `[]` | `[H]` | | `H: /foo/*/*` | `/foo//bar/baz` | `[H]` | `[]` | | `M: /p/x*/*`
`H: /p/x` | `/p/x` | `[H]` | `[M, H]` | | `H: /x*y` | `/x*y` | `[]` | `[H]` | | `H: /x*y/*` | `/x*y` | `[]` | `[H]` | ### The author should do the following, if applicable - [x] Add tests - [x] Run tests - [x] `pnpm run check:fix` to format and lint the code
